title: auto-apply facts card / 事实红线卡
description: Content Agent 唯一可引用的事实源。Intake 从简历与问诊生成，用户逐条签字；只有 status=confirmed 的事实可被引用。facts_card.md 由本 JSON 渲染。 / The only fact source the Content Agent may cite. Generated by Intake, signed fact by fact by the user; only status=confirmed facts are citable. facts_card.md is rendered from this JSON.

signed_by_user.description: 整卡签字：所有事实均为 confirmed 或 rejected 且用户明确确认 / Whole-card sign-off: every fact confirmed or rejected and user explicitly approved

resume_sha256.description: 生成时依据的简历指纹；简历变了要重签 / Resume fingerprints at generation; changes require re-signing

statement.description: 一句可核实的事实，含数字与时间 / One verifiable sentence with numbers and dates

statement_en.description: 英文版（若原句非英文） / English rendering if the statement is not in English

ref.description: 文件名/页码/问诊轮次 / File, page, or intake round

status.description: 只有 confirmed 可引用 / Only confirmed may be cited

usable_in_open_answers.description: 可用于开放题/CL / May be used in open answers and cover letters

sensitivity.description: restricted = 只在表单必填时使用，不写进开放题 / restricted = only when a form requires it

quantified.description: 是否含可量化结果 / Contains a quantified result

forbidden_claims.description: Content Agent 绝不可写的说法（用户明示） / Claims the Content Agent must never make
